quarterly_data.signal: Food Science: Mitsui will acquire a further 19% of Nutrinova Netherlands B.V. (high-intensity sweetener acesulfame potassium and preservatives sorbic acid / potassium sorbate) from its fellow shareholder Celanese, lifting its holding to 89%, and Nutrinova will move from an equity-method affiliate to a consolidated subsidiary; Nutrinova will also integrate the upstream intermediates producer VP4 Frankfurt GmbH (now owned by Sudarshan Germany Horizons), which Celanese will acquire and operate for a transitional period before ownership passes to Nutrinova, giving one chain from raw materials to finished products. Mitsui: growth investments under 'Wellness Ecosystem Creation 2.0' in its Medium-term Management Plan 2029.
